Record Class SimulationDate

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.core.time.SimulationDate
Record Components:
year - calendar year (negative for BCE/BP, positive for CE)
month - calendar month (1-12)
day - calendar day of month (1-30)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SimulationDate>
public record SimulationDate(int year, int month, int day) extends Record implements Comparable<SimulationDate>, Serializable

SimulationDate

Dedicated, immutable, strongly-typed temporal representation for macro-historical and planetary simulation chronologies across multi-millennial timescales (-100,000 BP to 2100+ CE). Uses canonical astronomical 360-day year (12 months of 30 days) ensuring strict bitwise determinism and linear step-independent temporal comparisons.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
